hidden_risks: Screen scratches or dead pixels visible only when off
Condition and functionality of HDMI and USB ports
Presence and working condition of the original remote control
Internal repair history or motherboard replacement
response.best_proof: Photo of the manufacturer sticker on the back panel showing the exact model and serial number
response.failure_mode: Assuming the exact model and import origin are correct without verifying the back label, and failing to check the condition of ports and inclusion of a remote.
